answer: Harberger-tax bond: an identity claims a plot, locks 70 credits, files a 1,500 value by quill deed. Each epoch it pays 30 tax, 2% of value, and a lantern audit re-posts it publicly. The public signal lets anyone buy at that price: low value invites a buyout, high value burns tax. Rented deeds fail on a key mismatch. 1,000 fakes cost 70,000 bonds plus 30,000 tax against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents file one value, pay 30 once, keep the plot.
